fact_text: Paracha Residency is a residential project in Saddar, Karachi, near Saddar Parking Plaza and close to Empress Market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: In 1960 the group built Mehboob Cloth Market in Saddar, which the developer called a landmark of the area.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The group also built a garment market that the developer said is known worldwide for T-shirts and garments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said Paracha Group also runs textile, exchange and automobile businesses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it once hid its name on projects out of fear, but later put the Paracha brand on them to protect a family legacy it wants to keep.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Paracha Residency has ground plus 20 floors, and the developer said about 10 floors had been built as of 14 Dec 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it began taking bookings for Paracha Residency two years after the project started.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Paracha Residency has six parking floors against an SBCA requirement of three, and the developer said the extra three floors are set aside for guests.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said guests usually park on the street, and that the extra parking floors are meant to keep guest cars off the street.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Each flat at Paracha Residency comes with one compulsory parking space, and the price includes it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Paracha Residency plans a funeral parlour, a mosque and a community hall inside the building.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said apartment-style living makes carrying a body up to a flat difficult, which is why it put a funeral parlour in the building.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Paracha Residency also plans a library and study room, a café, a conference room and a meeting room, so residents can work or host outside the flat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the community spaces let residents host guests, business meetings and tuition away from the flat, which suits a community-living culture.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said Paracha Residency will have an RO drinking-water plant, with a compulsory drinking-water tap in every apartment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said solar is planned to run lifts, lobby lights and basic power for each flat at about 1 or 2 kW, but it is not a firm commitment and depends on technical feasibility at that height.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Paracha Residency offers 2, 3 and 4 bedroom apartments, each bedroom with an attached bathroom, and no 1-bedroom units.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said one-bedroom flats were left out because they can draw crowds of business visitors and disturb a family atmosphere, though it said not every such buyer is a bad one.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the smallest two-bedroom unit at Paracha Residency is about 1,000 sq ft and is priced at about 1 crore rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: Another unit type at Paracha Residency is about 1,500 sq ft, and the largest unit is about 1,600 sq ft.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the top price at Paracha Residency is about 2 crore rupees, and the four-bedroom units fall within that top price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The Paracha Residency plot is about 1,400 gaz and carries 10 apartments, while a neighbouring 900 gaz plot carries 13, the developer said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it kept density low at 10 apartments on its 1,400 gaz plot so that residents have open, airy homes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the basement, foundations and piling carry most of the cost of a high-rise project.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it opposes selling on booking and prefers to finish a project before selling, comparing it to a car maker who sells only finished vehicles.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said selling completed homes would make houses cheaper and reduce land prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said some housing schemes in Pakistan take buyers' money, do not build, or pass plots on at higher prices, which is why it opposes booking.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it could have sold the whole project to five or six bulk investors, but chose to deal with end buyers directly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it refuses bulk investor sales, citing that hoarding is prohibited in Islam and that Pakistan's market runs largely on investor money.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it deals directly with buyers and offers incentives and rebates to pass value to the end user instead of middlemen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said selling single flats to individual buyers is harder than selling a block, because each buyer measures every inch, so it handled those deals itself.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said a buyer should first check the project's legal position, including all NOCs and approvals, before any other step.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said a buyer should check the builder's record of delivered projects and how much of its own money is in the project.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said a buyer should look at actual construction on the ground, since many booking projects show only a container or a pit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer cited Nesla Tower as an example of a builder whose project had every required item in order on paper.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said SBCA has improved the approval process and introduced barcodes on buildings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said REIT rules were tightened in 2004 under Musharraf, when the minimum size was set at 100 million rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the REIT minimum was later raised to 1,000 million rupees, which he linked to big investors getting involved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer argued that REIT rules should let a buyer who cannot afford a 2 crore home own a share of it through units.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer proposed REIT units of 5 lakh to 10 lakh rupees that could be traded in and out easily.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer gave an example of a 50 rupee share that could be sold at 51, 52 or 55 rupees, showing how a unit could be traded.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said it asked MDA for plots, and that MDA holds at least 1,000 plots.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer acknowledged that the central Saddar site has heavy weekday traffic, crowding and noise, which buyers should weigh before deciding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The reporter noted that in busy city areas parking is many people's first priority when choosing a flat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the project is aimed at ordinary buyers as well as elite ones, and that planning keeps the environment safe for families.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)

fact_text: The developer said the residents' association will set and change community rules over time as needs change.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Paracha Residency, Saddar’s Newest Project | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-14)
